answer: Sea Limited reported net income of US$1,610.9 million (~US$1.6 billion) for FY2025, up sharply from US$447.8 million in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-13]. Of this, total comprehensive income attributable to Sea Limited's ordinary shareholders was US$1,766.5 million, after accounting for non-controlling interests and other comprehensive income [Sea, FY2025, p.F-13].
